main_body: A fabric hammock sagging in a U-curve between two wooden posts, seen as a side profile; the posts are plain vertical shafts with no visible top faces.
top_band: none. The column scan through the hammock shows an outline row, a light cloth row, then graded cloth tones down to an outline. This is a single curved cloth profile with no horizontal top band. The posts have no top cap either.
evidence: The hammock is a side-on profile: the cloth is a thin curved ribbon with a crescent silhouette, and no horizontal surface is visible from above. The two posts are flat vertical rectangles whose tops are only a 1-2px rim, so they have no top face. The frame's beams and base show no top faces, so the piece fails the frame contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has 16 distinct colours and a median of 12 per tile, below the references (17 and 20 per tile, 38-40 colours) but not far below. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, and the dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outlines are tinted: dark brown beside the wood and a warm grey-brown beside the cloth. The posts have about 4-5 wood tones with a highlight, and the cloth has a 5-step ramp from cream to grey-brown, so the shading is reasonably built. Texture is limited to ramp banding with little grain or dot detail, and the pieces are simple, so the candidate reads a little thinner than the roofed well or the stall, but it would be acceptable next to them.
